title: Interface A v1: activity summary document (plaintext, before encryption)
description: What the agent uploads to the backend, as the content of an encrypted envelope (see interface-a-envelope.v1.schema.json). SUMMARIES ONLY: per-hour totals by category. It can never carry raw events, app names, site names, window titles, URLs, screenshots or typed text: every object is closed (additionalProperties false) and every string is a bounded identifier or timestamp. Spec: FR-9, FR-10, FR-13, 'What We Store' (Activity summaries: time by category, confidence, per hour).

batch_id.description: Idempotency key, generated once by the agent when the batch is created and reused on every retry of that batch.

device_id.description: Issued to the agent at activation (Interface D).

hours.description: One entry per completed hour. hour_start must be unique inside a batch. x-open-question OQ-A5 for the maximum length (744 = 31 days of offline catch-up is a proposal).

hourStart.description: Start of the hour in UTC, on the hour exactly.

categoryStats.description: Seconds spent in one category during the hour, and the confidence of those labels. confidence is null exactly when seconds is 0. How confidence is averaged is OQ-A8.

utc_offset_minutes.description: The user's local UTC offset during this hour, so the server can compute local hour-of-day and weekday/weekend (FR-15, FR-20). Not stated in the spec: OQ-A2.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and increases each time the agent recomputes this hour (for example after a correction is applied to the past, FR-8). The server keeps the highest revision per (device_id, hour_start). Not stated in the spec: OQ-A3.

categories.description: The five spec categories, always all present.

unknown_seconds.description: Seconds in this hour marked 'unknown' (gaps, crashes, extension silent). Never guessed into a category. Rule (checked by the receiver, not expressible here): the five category seconds plus unknown_seconds must not exceed 3600.

switches.description: App/tab switches in this hour (FR-13). Definition of a switch: OQ-A6.

interruptions.description: Interruption count in this hour (FR-13). The spec does not define an interruption: OQ-A6.

goal_match_percent.description: Share of this hour's activity that matched the daily goal, 0 to 100, or null if no goal was set (FR-12; 'match %' in 'What We Store'). The spec does not say whether the agent or the server computes it, or at what granularity: OQ-A4. Optional.
